title: LocalizedLabel
description: 🗺️ The wire shape of a LocalizedLabel: one text per (terminology, locale) cell of 🖱️ui/🎚️axes/🔣️.json. Every cell is required and no other key is admitted, so a carrier that fills one locale and leaves the other to a fallback is refused here rather than reaching a panel. The axis key sets are asserted equal to the generated Locale/Terminology enums by both this schema's readers (🌐️locale/🧪️tests/🏷️localized-label-fixture in Rust, 🎠️kernel/🧪️tests/🏷️localized-label-fixture in TypeScript), so adding an axis fails until this file carries it.
